text:
jordan: Quick pre-launch check for the EU change window at 22:00 UTC. Freeze starts 21:30 UTC. Please confirm pins, smoke run plan, and rollback lanes. Deploy bot will auto-pin canary if approvals are here by 21:15.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: deploy/canary-eu v2.3.1 -> canary-pool. Will auto-pin in 15m unless someone issues /hold or a QA fail is reported.

sasha: QA smoke checklist ready — basic inference, streaming, token billing, and end-to-end auth. I can run the smoke at 21:20 UTC.

maria: +1 on smoke. Holding off on pin until we validate the quantization RPC fix in canary. If green, I'll approve the pin.

alex: Infra note: if canary fails, rollback policy is auto-fallback to v2.2.9 within 5m. Rollback runbook prepared: https://wiki.redwood.dev/runbooks/rollback-eu (infra checklist included).

jordan: @maria please /approve when smoke is green. @deploy-bot please /hold until we get explicit approval from QA.

deploy-bot: Received /hold. Canary will still deploy to canary pool but will NOT auto-pin.

maria: Running smoke now... initial logs show intermittent 502s on streaming edge under load. Investigating with runtime team.

sasha: copying failing snippet:
```
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.eu.redwood.dev/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq .
# response: 502 Bad Gateway (x12)
```

alex: If streaming edge is flaky, do NOT pin. I'll open the emergency rollback lane and prepare traffic hold. Assigning infra oncall.

jordan: Decision: abort canary pin and keep the freeze. No rollout today. @maria escalate if fix lands before 22:00 UTC and we'll consider hotfix exemption.

maria: Filed issue #3871, tagged runtime and eng-platform. ETA for patch ~45m. Will update thread.

sasha: Smoke result: FAIL — not ready :cry:

jordan: Thanks everyone. I'm updating the launch board and release notes to mark the change window aborted. If runtime posts a hotfix we'll follow the hotfix exemption and emergency rollback playbook.

#actions
- jordan: update launch board & release notes
- maria: follow up on #3871 and update thread
- alex: keep rollback lane warm
- sasha: re-run smoke after patch

:thumbsup:
